description: Turn underline and strikethrough on, off or toggle them, and set their options: weight, offset, type, colour, tint, overprint, gap colour, gap tint and gap overprint (Character panel menu > Underline Options and Strikethrough Options; the Underline and Strikethrough shortcuts). Weights and offsets are points

strikethrough.description: Strikethrough (Character panel menu > Strikethrough Options; Type shortcut)

color.description: Strikethrough colour: a swatch name in the document, "None", or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

gapColor.description: Colour of the gaps in dashed, dotted or striped lines: a swatch name in the document, "None", or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

toggle.description: Toggle on or off, as the keyboard shortcut does: turns it on unless the first character already has it

type.description: Stroke type by name, as in the Stroke panel (Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Thick - Thin, ...)

target.description: Which text to act on. Give storyIds (get_document_stories), frameIds (text frame ids from list_page_items), or selection: true; optionally narrow to a range of paragraphs

frameIds.description: Text frames, by page item id: the text in each frame

paragraphs.description: Only these paragraphs of each text (0-based)

count.description: How many paragraphs (default: to the end)

selection.description: Use the selected text, or the text of the selected text frames

wholeStory.description: Widen frames and selected text to their whole stories

underline.description: Underline (Character panel menu > Underline Options; Type shortcut Shift+Cmd+U)

color.description: Underline colour: a swatch name in the document, "None", or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

gapColor.description: Colour of the gaps in dashed, dotted or striped lines: a swatch name in the document, "None", or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

toggle.description: Toggle on or off, as the keyboard shortcut does: turns it on unless the first character already has it

type.description: Stroke type by name, as in the Stroke panel (Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Thick - Thin, ...)

name: set_underline_and_strikethrough
title: Set Underline And Strikethrough
